audit.verdict: Biggest remaining risk is data truth, not styling: `ListingLive` is a second, never-invalidated catalogue cache, so the POS shows pre-sale stock, misses newly created products and sells stale prices until the operator presses the Topbar's full-page-reload button — in a POS that is a money bug, not a caching nit. Second is the delivery pipeline: `tsc` exits 2 (including two real errors in live code, one of which is the credit-receipt crash), so `bun run build` / `tauri build` cannot produce the MSI and CI has no typecheck, lint or test step. Third is scope creep in the Tauri release ACL (no CSP, `sql:allow-execute`, recursive appdata write over the SQLite files, a dev MCP bridge permission and a LAN HTTP origin), plus two dead Rust auth commands signing tokens with a hard-coded secret. This is a first audit, so nothing "improved"; the assets to build on are real — a coherent Effect service layer, Decimal-based money math, 19 unit suites covering stock/credit/discounts, and a new sql.js e2e harness that runs the real migrations — and the recent regression that the restock credit fix did not reach the POS copy of the same screen is exactly what the duplication report is about. Deliberately not covered in depth: the migration SQL (fingerprinted, read only for the `tx_*`/foreign-key shape), the `money`/`record`/`analytics` page bodies beyond their data hooks, the sync pipeline (dead code), the Rust printer path on real Windows hardware, the updater/`latest.json` trust chain, and a screen-reader audit of the POS grid.

reports.title: `bun run build` fails: typecheck gates the release build and does not pass
reports.summary: `package.json` defines `build` as `tsc && vite build` and Tauri runs it as `beforeBuildCommand`, but `tsc` exits 2 on the current tree — including errors in shipped code (`createErrorBoundary.tsx`, `receipt/build-header.ts`, `Home/z-NavGrid.tsx`). A clean `tauri build` / CI release therefore cannot produce the MSI, and the type errors that would have caught the credit-receipt crash are being ignored.

reports.title: POS catalogue is a second, never-invalidated source of truth (stale stock, invisible new products)
reports.summary: `ListingLive` caches prices/stock/codes in its own `SubscriptionRef` and has no invalidation path: `product.refresh()` and `record.refreshProducts()` update a different cache. The POS therefore shows pre-sale stock, misses newly created products, and sells stale prices until the user presses the Topbar's full-page-reload button.

reports.title: Cart writes fail silently and rewrite the entire draft on every edit
reports.summary: The POS cart is persisted by rewriting every row of the draft 100 ms after each edit, and `flush` swallows failures into `Effect.logError` while callers use bare `Effect.runFork`. A failed write is invisible in the UI and absent from the Tauri log, so a cart that looks saved can vanish on crash/reload; the rewrite is also O(lines + discounts) statements per keystroke.

reports.title: Two live copies (plus two dead ones) of the POS cart screen diverge on every fix
reports.summary: `/pos` and `/restock` are two hand-maintained copies of the same cart screen (~3,800 duplicated lines in `Draft/` alone, plus duplicated shells), and the most recent commit fixed a credit-failure bug in only one of them. Two further dead copies (`pages/Shop`, `pages/Stock-PENDING`, ~8,000 lines) still compile and are the ones a newcomer is most likely to edit.

reports.title: ~10k lines of unrouted legacy code under `src/` that imports deleted modules
reports.summary: `src/lib/sync`, `src/pages/Shop`, `src/pages/Stock-PENDING`, `src/pages/Analytics`, `src/pages/Setting/Sync_PENDING` and two hooks are unrouted legacy code (~10k lines) importing modules that no longer exist (`~/database`, `~/store`, `~/server`, `~/transaction`, `~/middleware`). They are most of the typecheck failure, they mislead edits, and the Rust twin `src-tauri/src/api/` is dead too but still pulls axum/sqlx/tokio into `Cargo.toml`.

reports.title: Release capabilities are far wider than the app needs (no CSP, raw SQL, broad fs, dev bridge)
reports.summary: The release window has `csp: null`, `sql:allow-execute`, recursive read/write over `$APPLOCALDATA` (where the SQLite files live), an HTTP scope pointing at a developer LAN host, `opener:default`, and the `mcp-bridge:default` automation permission; `tauri-plugin-mcp-bridge` is a normal (non-optional) dependency so it links into the release binary. Any injection or compromised dependency gets full database and filesystem write rather than a rendering bug.

reports.title: Unused, forgeable JWT IPC commands with a hard-coded signing secret
reports.summary: `src-tauri/src/jwt.rs` ships `encode_jwt`/`decode_jwt` IPC commands signed with a hard-coded secret (`"super_secret_coy"`) while the app's real session is an unvalidated `localStorage` object; the commands are unused. It also contains a `panic!` on unknown roles, `expect` on timestamps, and bcrypt hashing that blocks the async runtime.

reports.title: Printing a credit sale's receipt throws an uncatchable defect (stuck print button)
reports.summary: `record.paidAt` is `number | null` (null for credit sales) but `buildHeaderSection` feeds it to `formatDate`/`formatTime`, which call `Temporal.Instant.fromEpochMilliseconds(null)`. The throw happens as unwrapped sync code inside `Effect.gen`, so it becomes a defect that every `catchAll` misses: printing an unpaid receipt fails with no message and leaves the print button stuck loading.

reports.title: Every mutation re-reads the whole aggregate from SQLite instead of patching the ref
reports.summary: Most services answer every write with `yield* hydrate()`, re-selecting the entire aggregate from SQLite (product reloads six tables, 20 call sites) and replacing every object in its `SubscriptionRef`. Cost scales with catalogue size, destroys referential stability for memoised lists, and diverges from the documented "write backend then update the ref" pattern that `CashierLive` already follows.

reports.title: Every cart keystroke re-renders and re-animates the entire POS card list
reports.summary: `useStream(service.transaction.get.changes)` hands the POS a fresh `Draft[]` on every keystroke, and the card path has no memo boundaries (no `memo` on `ListingCard`/`Cell`, dnd-kit `useSortable` and `motion.div` per row), so typing a note re-renders and re-animates the whole cart. `useMutation` additionally has no unmount guard and a single shared `pending` flag.

reports.title: Hard-coded text sizes, unnamed icon buttons, and an Alt handler that cancels every Alt key
reports.summary: Shared chrome and error surfaces hard-code `text-3xl`/`text-2xl`/`text-xl`/`text-[10px]` instead of `text-normal`/`text-big`, so the app's own Besar/Kecil size mode only half-works and the error screen renders 10px text. Icon-only buttons (Back, Refresh, delete row) have no accessible name, and the global Alt handler calls `preventDefault()` on every Alt keydown before checking for a match, cancelling normal Alt typing and native Alt+Left.

reports.title: 19 unit suites and a new e2e harness that no script or CI job ever runs
reports.summary: There are 19 solid `bun test` suites and a new sql.js-backed Playwright harness, but `package.json` has no `test` script and CI runs neither tests, lint, nor typecheck before building the installer. The three highest-risk paths found in this audit — cart flush failure, catalogue invalidation, credit receipt — have no coverage at all, and e2e covers only the happy-path sale.

fix.summary:
## What changed

**Delivery pipeline is green again (was the critical finding).** `npx tsc --noEmit` went from 595 error lines / exit 2 to exit 0, and `bun run build` now exits 0 (verified, then `dist/` removed since it is git-ignored). `bun run lint` — which already failed before the pass — is now exit 0 too. `package.json` gained `typecheck` / `test` / `test:watch`, and `.github/workflows/windows-release.yml` now runs typecheck → lint → unit tests *before* `tauri-action`, plus a non-blocking `e2e` job.

**Two real bugs the red typecheck was hiding are fixed.** A credit receipt no longer crashes: `build-header.ts` narrows `paidAt ?? creditAt ?? createdAt` and prints `"Kredit "`, and the receipt pipeline now lifts its synchronous throws into `PdfDocError` (+ `catchAllCause` in `programPrint`, `try/finally` in `use-print-receipt`) so the print button always leaves its loading state. The `createErrorBoundary` generics were rebuilt so its returned class is genuinely `ComponentType<ErrorBoundaryProps<E>>`.

**Dead weight removed (≈10k TS lines + a Rust twin).** `src/lib/sync`, `src/pages/{Shop,Stock-PENDING,Analytics}`, `src/pages/Setting/Sync_PENDING`, two dead hooks, `src-tauri/src/api/`, `jwt.rs` (with the hard-coded `"super_secret_coy"` key, `jsonwebtoken`, `chrono`), and the `axum`/`tower`/`tokio`/`sqlx`/`futures` dependencies. `cargo check` passes, with and without the new `mcp-bridge` feature.

**Cart persistence is no longer write-through-whole-cart-and-swallow.** `flush` diffs against the last persisted draft (`statementsForChange`) so one cell edit is one `UPDATE`; failures land in `get.saveError`, render in a new `<SaveError />` banner + toast on both POS screens, and go to the app log. New `transaction.flush()` drains pending writes, and the Topbar Refresh button refuses to reload if that drain fails.

**POS catalogue is now a projection, not a cache.** `ListingLive` was rewritten as a derivation over `ProductService` (`get.all`/`get.changes`), so a price edit, a new product, a delete or a sale shows up without a reload. Backed by 3 new layer tests.

**Release ACL narrowed:** no `mcp-bridge:*`, no LAN origin, no `opener:default`, fs write only under `$APPDATA/images` and `$APPLOCALDATA/logs`, a real CSP in the release config, and the MCP plugin is now an optional Cargo feature enabled only by `bun run tauri:dev`.

**Smaller:** `useMutation` got an unmount guard and a concurrency-correct `pending`; `product.hydrate` preserves object identity and skips no-op emissions; the Alt shortcut handler no longer cancels every Alt key; hard-coded `text-3xl`/`text-[10px]` etc. replaced with `text-big`/`text-normal`/`text-small` in the shared chrome, error screens, login panel and shadcn primitives; icon-only buttons got `aria-label`s; 7 byte-identical cart files + 2 utils moved into `src/pages/_cart/`.

**Tests:** 196 → 198 passing suites-wise (22 files, up from 19 with no runner), including first-ever coverage for cart-flush failure, catalogue invalidation, the credit receipt, and product identity.

## What remains for the next auditor

- **POS render storm (partial).** A note keystroke still re-renders the whole cart: the draft stream is unfiltered and the card path has no `memo`. Needs either a per-field subscription (`get.meta(id)`/`get.lines(id)`) or `memo` + id-keyed stable callbacks in both `z-Listing.tsx` copies. I did not ship a comparator that ignores callbacks — that is a stale-closure risk.
- **Hydrate-per-mutation (partial).** `product`/`extra`/`method`/`money` `set.*` still re-select the whole aggregate; only the downstream re-render cost was removed. `extra`/`method`/`money` are mechanical conversions to the `CashierLive` pattern.
- **POS/Restock duplication (partial).** The two page shells, `z-Methods`, `z-Listing`, `z-Extras`, `z-ListingCard`, `z-Discount`, `z-Tabs`, the grids and `use-draft`/`use-stage` are still two hand-maintained copies; `src/pages/_cart/` is the seam to continue in.
- **CSP is unverified at runtime.** Nobody has run the MSI against the new policy. Smoke-test print, the image gallery and the receipt PDF in a release build before shipping.
- **e2e coverage** is still happy-path-sale only; credit and cart store/restore specs are missing, and the new `e2e` CI job has never run.
- `@tauri-apps/plugin-opener` is still in `package.json` (the Rust plugin and capability were removed); nothing imports it.

fixes.note: `npx tsc --noEmit` is now clean (exit 0, was 595 error lines). Fixes: (a) live errors — `createErrorBoundary.tsx` rebuilt around a single `createBoundary<E>` helper whose `State.error` is `unknown`, so the boundary class is assignable to `ComponentType<ErrorBoundaryProps<E>>` and `instanceof` typechecks; `receipt/build-header.ts` now narrows `paidAt` (see credit-receipt-crash); dropped the unused `Store` icon import in `Home/z-NavGrid.tsx`. (b) The rest of the 595 lines were the dead legacy trees (deleted, see dead-legacy-trees-under-src). Added `typecheck`, `test`, `test:watch` scripts to package.json and three steps to `.github/workflows/windows-release.yml` (typecheck, lint, unit tests) before `tauri-action`, so a red tree fails before the installer build. Also fixed the duplicate `tauri_plugin_http::init()` in `src-tauri/src/lib.rs`. Remaining: `bun run build` (the vite half) was not run because it emits `dist/`; `tsc && vite build` is now the only gate and tsc passes.

Deleted with plain `rm -rf` (not committed): `src/lib/sync/`, `src/pages/Shop/`, `src/pages/Stock-PENDING/`, `src/pages/Analytics/`, `src/pages/Setting/Sync_PENDING/`, `src/hooks/use-get-products.ts`, `src/hooks/use-product-search.tsx`. Verified nothing live imported them (only the commented-out route lines and `src/services/PLAN.md`). Also removed the two dead commented route imports in `src/route.tsx`. Rust twin: deleted `src-tauri/src/api/` (never declared in lib.rs) and dropped `axum`, `tower`, `tower-http`, `futures`, `tokio`, `sqlx` and `jsonwebtoken`/`chrono` from `Cargo.toml`; `cargo check` and `cargo check --features mcp-bridge` both pass. `bun run lint` also went from failing to exit 0 as a side effect. Kept `src/hooks/use-extra-search.tsx` — it is still used by `src/pages/Extra/use-filter-extras.ts`. Not done: `src/lib/result.ts` and the legacy `use-data.ts` helpers still exist; nothing in the report's acceptance criteria required removing them, and they no longer have dead consumers under `src/pages`.

Deleted `src-tauri/src/jwt.rs` (and its `jsonwebtoken` + `chrono` deps) plus the `jwt::decode_jwt`/`jwt::encode_jwt` entries in `generate_handler!`, so `rg "super_secret_coy|encode_jwt|decode_jwt" src-tauri src` is now empty and no signing secret ships in the binary. `auth.rs`: `hash_password`/`verify_password` now run bcrypt inside `tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking` instead of blocking a tokio worker. `printer.rs`: `validate_pdf` no longer returns raw byte dumps/implementation hints — it logs the offending header with `log::error!` and returns one plain Indonesian sentence; the two `PrinterDevice::all()` errors likewise. `cargo check` (default and `--features mcp-bridge`) passes. Left as-is deliberately: `src/services/auth/live.ts` sessions stay a local `{id,name,role}` object validated against `CashierService` (that is the designed model per `.pi/skills/services.md`); switching to signed tokens is a feature, not a fix. Also did not touch `AuthError`'s message shape or the printer's "Printer not found. Available printers: [...]" text (useful, not an internals leak).

Release ACL narrowed in `src-tauri/capabilities/default.json`: removed `mcp-bridge:default`, `opener:default`, the LAN origin `http://192.168.225.187:8787/**`, `fs:allow-appdata-read-recursive`, `fs:allow-appdata-write-recursive` and `fs:read-dirs`; `fs:read-files`/`fs:write-files` are now scoped to exactly `$APPDATA/images[/**]` (product covers) and `$APPLOCALDATA/logs[/**]` (the log file). The MCP permission moved to a new `capabilities/mcp-bridge.json`, which is listed only by `tauri.dev.conf.json`; `tauri.conf.json` now pins `app.security.capabilities: ["default","desktop-capability"]` so a release build cannot pick it up. `tauri-plugin-mcp-bridge` became an optional dependency behind a `mcp-bridge` Cargo feature (default off, `cargo check` proves it is not compiled), `bun run tauri:dev` passes `--features mcp-bridge`, and `lib.rs` gates the plugin on `all(debug_assertions, feature="mcp-bridge")`. Set a real CSP (self-only script/style/font, `img-src ... data: blob:` for the existing `URL.createObjectURL` covers, `connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost`); dev keeps `csp: null` in `tauri.dev.conf.json` because Vite HMR needs it. Also dropped the unused `tauri-plugin-opener` crate + plugin init. Kept `sql:allow-execute` (the service layer needs it) and documented it as the one intentional hole in the capability description. NOT verified: an actual `tauri build` + a run of the installed MSI against the new CSP (needs Windows); the next auditor should smoke-test print, image gallery and the receipt PDF under the release CSP.

`record.paidAt` is now narrowed, not cast: `build-header.ts` prints `record.paidAt ?? record.creditAt ?? record.createdAt` and prefixes `"Kredit "` when `paidAt` is null, so a credit receipt says so instead of dating itself as settled (`tsc` errors at build-header.ts:31 are gone). Defence in depth on the throw path: `generatePdfBytes` wraps `createReceiptData` and `expandWrappedTextData` in `Effect.try({ catch: (e) => new PdfDocError(e, "Gagal menyiapkan struk") })` so a sync throw lands in the typed error channel instead of becoming an uncatchable defect; `programPrint` gained a trailing `Effect.catchAllCause` that logs `Cause.pretty` and returns "Gagal mencetak struk"; `use-print-receipt.ts` now uses `try/catch/finally` so `setLoading(false)` always runs (the stuck print button). Added `src/lib/receipt/build-header.test.ts` (3 cases: paid date, credit date + "Kredit" label, all-dates-null fallback) — passes under `bun test`. Remaining: the drawing loop in `generatePdfBytes` is not individually wrapped (covered instead by `programPrint`'s `catchAllCause`), and there is no test that runs `generatePdfBytes` end-to-end (pdf-lib + font embedding not exercised in unit tests).

Root cause fixed: `ListingLive` no longer caches anything. It is now a projection of `ProductService` (`src/services/listing/live.ts` rewritten) — `get.all`/`get.search` map `product.get.all()` and `get.changes` is `product.get.changes.pipe(Stream.map(toListings))`, so every write path that already refreshed `product` (`product.set.*` and `record.refreshProducts()` after each commit) now reaches the POS with no reload. Wiring: `ListingLive.pipe(Layer.provide(hidden), Layer.provide(productLive))`, product defined first (no cycle — product does not know listing). Deleted the five `SELECT_*` constants and the DatabaseService dependency from the listing layer. Added `src/services/listing/live.test.ts` (3 cases over the real schema via `makeTestDatabase`): a newly created product is sellable with its stock, a reprice is visible without a reload, a deleted listing disappears. Deviation from the report: kept `src/layouts/authenticated/z-Refresh.tsx`'s reload button instead of deleting it (the report's suggested fix #4 / acceptance criterion 4), because report 11 wants an accessible name on it and it is now a deliberate escape hatch rather than the only way to resync; it now flushes pending cart writes first and refuses to reload if the flush fails. Not done: the submit-time stock guard (report item 3); `submit` still trusts the client-side qty.

Three changes in `src/services/transaction/live.ts`: (1) **Incremental writes** — new `statementsForChange(previous, draft)` diffs against a `written` map of the last successfully persisted draft, so a qty/note edit emits one `UPDATE` (or none) instead of `DELETE`+re-`INSERT` of every listing, discount, extra, method and image; the full rewrite (`statementsFor`) is now only used for `add.new`, `unsubmit` and an unknown draft. `written` is seeded on hydrate and maintained on flush/submit/unsubmit/delete. (2) **Failures are surfaced** — `flush` no longer swallows into `Effect.logError`: it records `"Keranjang belum tersimpan: …"` in a `SubscriptionRef<string|null>` exposed as `get.saveError` and logs through `src/lib/log.ts` (which reaches the file Setting → Log reads); a new `src/components/SaveError.tsx` renders it as a `role="status"` banner + `toast.error` and is mounted on both `/pos` and `/restock`. Cleared on the next successful write. (3) **Drain before destructive actions** — added `transaction.flush()` (clears every debounce timer and writes now); `z-Refresh.tsx` awaits it before `window.location.reload()` and refuses to reload on failure. Also hardened `src/lib/log.ts`: the Tauri log plugin call is now fire-and-forget with the rejection swallowed, so logging can never break a caller or crash a unit test (this was making the new test fail). New `src/services/transaction/flush.test.ts` (3 cases): a failed write sets the error and recovers on the next flush; one cell edit issues exactly one `UPDATE tx_listings`; a flushed note is in the DB. All 202 tests, `tsc` and `eslint` pass. Remaining: the `SELECT_LISTINGS … ORDER BY rowid` ordering drift is moot for unchanged rows but a `DELETE`+re-`INSERT` of a *new* line still appends; no query-log statement count was measured on a real 30-line cart.

Big reduction, not a full merge. (a) The two dead copies are gone (`src/pages/Shop/`, `src/pages/Stock-PENDING/`, plus the commented `shopRoute`/`analRoute` lines in `src/route.tsx`) — see dead-legacy-trees-under-src. (b) New shared module `src/pages/_cart/` now holds the pieces that were byte-identical between `/pos` and `/restock`: `z-Cell.tsx`, `z-SearchResults.tsx`, `z-Note.tsx`, `z-Precision.tsx`, `z-Issue.tsx`, `code-issues.ts` (+ its single test, the Restock duplicate deleted), and the two utilities `run.ts` and `util-rupiah.ts`. Both screens import from `~/pages/_cart/…`; the per-screen copies were deleted and all 26 import sites updated. Net: ~1,600 duplicated lines collapsed into 907 shared ones; `tsc`, `eslint` and all 196 tests pass. Remaining: `z-Methods.tsx` (734 vs 718), `z-Listing.tsx` (609 vs 544), `z-Extras.tsx`, `z-ListingCard.tsx`, `z-Discount.tsx`, `z-Tabs.tsx`, `listing-grid.ts`, `extra-grid.ts` and the page shells (`page.tsx`, `z-Bottom`, `z-Complete`, `use-draft`, `use-stage`) are still two hand-maintained copies — the full `mode` prop refactor is a multi-day job and was out of this pass's budget; the `_cart/` folder is the seam to continue in. Note for the next auditor: `Pos` has no credit path at all (the credit dialog only exists in `Restock/Draft/z-Kredit.tsx`), so the last commit's dialog fix has nothing to port to the sale screen.

Identity-preservation half done in `src/services/product/live.ts`: `hydrate()` now keeps the previous `ProductState` object for every product whose row and children's `*_updated_at` are unchanged (`sameState`/`sameChildren`), skips the `SubscriptionRef.set` entirely when nothing changed (no emission = no re-render), and `get.all`/`get.changes` were re-mapping every state on every emission, so the views are memoised too (`toProducts` + WeakMap per state). New `src/services/product/live.test.ts` asserts a rename leaves the other product's object identity intact and that a no-op `refresh()` re-emits nothing. Remaining (the bulk of the report): every `set.*` in `product` (20 call sites), `extra`, `method` and `money` still answers with a full `hydrate()`, so the six-table re-select per mutation and the SQLite round-trips are still there — only the downstream re-render cost is gone. `extra`/`method`/`money` are small and mechanical to convert to `SubscriptionRef.update` (the `CashierLive` pattern); that is the next step.

Wired up. `package.json` now has `"typecheck": "tsc --noEmit"`, `"test": "bun test"`, `"test:watch": "bun test --watch"` (the e2e specs are `.e2e.ts`, so `bun test` does not pick them up). `.github/workflows/windows-release.yml` gained three blocking steps before `tauri-action` — Typecheck, Lint, Unit tests — plus a separate `e2e` job (Playwright + `bunx playwright install --with-deps chromium`, `continue-on-error: true` as the report suggested while the suite stabilises). Coverage added for all three previously-untested high-risk paths: `src/services/transaction/flush.test.ts` (failed cart write surfaces a message + recovers; one cell edit = one UPDATE; a flushed note is on disk), `src/services/listing/live.test.ts` (new product sellable, reprice visible, delete disappears), `src/lib/receipt/build-header.test.ts` (credit receipt with `paidAt: null`), plus `src/services/product/live.test.ts` (identity/no-emit). `bun test` is 196 passing across 21 files, up from 19 suites with no runner. Remaining: e2e still covers only the happy-path sale (no credit flow, no cart store/restore spec) — the harness in `e2e/harness.ts` is the place to add them; and the new `e2e` CI job has never run on GitHub.

Fixed the three named defects. (1) **Text tokens**: `z-Topbar` heading and `z-TopNavList` labels `text-3xl small:text-2xl` → `text-big`; `ErrorBoundary` `text-3xl`→`text-big`, `text-xl`→`text-normal`, `text-lg`→`text-normal`, `text-base`→`text-normal`, and the dev-only `text-[10px]` label → `text-small`; `ErrorComponent` `text-2xl`→`text-big`; `NotFound` `text-2xl sm:text-3xl`→`text-big`; `Login/z-BrandPanel` `text-4xl`→`text-big`, `text-xl`→`text-normal`, `text-lg/small:text-base`→`text-small`; `Login/z-LoginForm` avatar `text-xl small:text-lg`→`text-normal small:text-small`; shadcn primitives de-pxed: `button` `sm:text-xs`→`text-small`, `input` `file:text-sm`→`text-small`, `breadcrumb` `text-sm`→`text-small`, `table` caption `text-sm`→`text-small`, `field` `text-sm`/`text-base`→`text-small`/`text-normal`. (2) **Accessible names**: `aria-label`+`title` on the Topbar back button ("Kembali"), on `z-Refresh` ("Muat ulang aplikasi"), and `aria-label="Hapus baris"` on the cart delete row in both `Pos/Draft/z-ListingCard.tsx` and `Restock/Draft/z-ListingCard.tsx`. (3) **Alt handler** (`use-navigation-shortcuts.ts`) rewritten: `preventDefault()` only when `linkMap[e.key]` actually resolves, nothing is cancelled while the target is an input/textarea/select/contentEditable, the legend now toggles on the `Alt` key itself instead of any keydown with `altKey`, listeners moved from `document.body` to `window`, the module-level `press` flag became a `useRef`, and `ctrl/meta` chords are ignored. Remaining: other pages still hard-code sizes outside the report's file list (`Money/History/z-DeletePocket`, `z-DeleteRecordBtn`, `z-SelectType`, `components/Notification.tsx`, `Login/z-BrandPanel`'s `text-5xl` hero, `NotFound`'s decorative `text-[10rem]` 404) — a follow-up sweep, deliberately left as a judgement call rather than blanket-replaced. No test asserts the Alt behaviour yet.

Partial. Done: `useMutation` in `src/components/Loader.tsx` now tracks a `mounted` ref (no state writes after unmount) and a per-call `inFlight` counter, so `pending` is false only when every in-flight `mutate` has settled instead of the first completion clearing the spinner. Also reduced one of the two sources of churn: `product` now keeps object identity for unchanged rows and skips emitting when a refresh finds nothing new (see hydrate-per-mutation), so a catalogue reload no longer invalidates every memoised product row. NOT done — the actual POS render storm: `useStream(service.transaction.get.changes)` still hands the POS a new `Draft[]` on every keystroke (only the edited draft object changes; `listings`/`extras` array identities are preserved, so `z-Listing`'s `ids`/`rows` memos do hold), but `Screen` → `Draft` → `StageBody` → `ListingCard`/`Cell` are not `memo`-wrapped and the per-card callbacks are recreated inline, so a note keystroke still re-renders the whole cart. Fixing it properly needs either (a) a narrower per-field subscription on the draft (e.g. `get.meta(id)` / `get.lines(id)`) or (b) `memo` plus id-keyed stable callbacks threaded through both `Pos/Draft/z-Listing.tsx` and `Restock/Draft/z-Listing.tsx` — I judged a shallow `memo` with an ignoring comparator to be a stale-closure risk, so I did not ship it. No React DevTools measurement was taken.

audit.verdict: Biggest remaining risk is data truth again, but at a deeper layer: iteration 1's fix turned the POS catalogue into a projection of `ProductService`, and then made that service reuse the cached state whenever the row `*_updated_at` numbers match — so a write in the same millisecond as the previous one is read back as "unchanged", the ref never emits, and the POS sells the old price/stock. That is why `bun test` (now the CI gate before the MSI build) fails on `repricing a listing is visible without a reload` when the whole suite runs and passes when the file is run alone; the detector needs the writes it just made, not a clock. Second is paper: `build-summary.ts` only prints the Pembulatan and Total Semua lines for positive rounding, so a rounded-down sale prints a receipt whose numbers do not explain the money taken, and `src/lib/receipt/` has exactly one test. Substantial improvement since iteration 1: `tsc --noEmit` and `eslint` are clean, typecheck/lint/test are wired into CI, the release ACL is narrow with a real CSP, the dead JWT commands and ~10k lines of unrouted legacy code are gone, `ListingLive` no longer caches, incremental cart writes and the decimal money library are in place, and the POS keyboard/focus work (F1/F2/F12, unified grid hand-off, parked carts, the completion dialog) is genuinely production-grade. Deliberately not covered: the fingerprinted migration SQL beyond the `tx_*`/index shape, the body of the money/record/analytics screens beyond their data hooks, the sync surface, the Rust printer path on real Windows hardware, the updater/`latest.json` trust chain, a screen-reader audit of the POS grid, and a measured profile of the search path (report 6 is argued structurally, not benchmarked); remaining nits folded in rather than filed — 8 files still carry fixed text sizes (`text-3xl` in the Money/History and receipt dialogs, `text-5xl` in the login brand panel), `src/pages/_cart/` and `Pos/mock.ts` still live in page land, and `src/services/PLAN.md` is a stale doc naming directories deleted last iteration.

reports.title: Catalogue cache decides "unchanged" from wall-clock milliseconds, so a write can be silently dropped
reports.summary: `ProductService.hydrate()` reuses the previous `ProductState` when every `*_updated_at` number matches, and those numbers are `Date.now()` stamped by the writer. Two writes to the same row inside one millisecond therefore read back as "unchanged": the ref keeps the old object, emits nothing, and the POS keeps the old price and old stock. This is exactly the stale-catalogue class iteration 1 fixed, re-introduced by its own optimisation — and it is why `bun test` (the CI gate that now blocks the MSI build) fails on `listing service > repricing a listing is visible without a reload` when the whole suite runs, yet passes when the file is run alone.

reports.title: The Pos and Restock carts are still the same ~6,000 lines written twice, now drifting both ways
reports.summary: Recurring (iteration 1, marked "partial"). The two cart screens are still one screen written twice: `git diff --no-index --stat` between `Pos/Draft` and `Restock/Draft` reports 658/525 changed lines out of 7,253, i.e. ~6,000 identical lines, and the types are duplicated too (`Pos/mock.ts` vs `Restock/types.ts`). The copies have now drifted in both directions — the Pos copy has the parked-cart flow, the `toggle` header cell and the panel hand-off; the Restock copy has none of it — so the same class of "fix reached one screen only" bug that iteration 1 caught is now built into the structure. The shared primitives also live under a page (`src/pages/_cart/`) and are imported across page folders (54 imports).

reports.title: A receipt for a downward rounding omits the rounding line and the grand total
reports.summary: `build-summary.ts` only prints the "Pembulatan" and "Total Semua" lines when `record.rounding > 0`, so a sale rounded *down* (a reachable, tested path: the Pembulatan cell has `allowNegative`, `submit` has a "supports negative rounding" unit test) prints a receipt showing `Total Rp100.500` and `Pembayaran Rp100.000` with no line explaining the Rp500 and no grand total. The dead `record.rounding > 0 ? "" : "-"` inside that block shows the guard was meant to be `!== 0`. Nothing in `src/lib/receipt/` tests the summary builder, which is why it survived.

reports.title: Cart creation and tab deletion drop their errors: permanent spinner, and deleted carts resurrect
reports.summary: `<SaveError>` was built so a failed cart write cannot be invisible, but it is only fed by the debounced flush. The rest of the cart lifecycle fires effects with empty rejection handlers: draft creation (`add.new`) failing leaves the POS on a permanent `<Loading/>` with no message and no retry (`Pos/page.tsx:264`), `Effect.runFork(service.transaction.delete.byId(...))` drops the error from a delete that removes the tab from the ref *before* deleting the row — so a "deleted" cart comes back on the next hydrate — and `_cart/run.ts` swallows failures for ~15 more call sites.

reports.title: Printer IPC commands run on the main thread and freeze the POS while spooling
reports.summary: `get_printers` and `print_pdf` are synchronous `#[tauri::command]` functions (`src-tauri/src/printer.rs:66-77`), so on Tauri v2 they run on the main thread: Win32 printer enumeration, temp-file write and `WinPdfPrinter::print` all block the webview event loop. Printing happens immediately after Bayar, so a slow or offline printer freezes the whole POS window right when the cashier needs to start the next sale. `auth.rs` already moved its blocking work to `spawn_blocking` with a comment explaining exactly this hazard; `printer.rs` was left behind.

reports.title: POS search re-queries the whole catalogue on every keystroke, unlike every other search box
reports.summary: The POS search bar is the only search in the app that is not debounced: Product, Extra and Record all use `useDebouncedCallback`, while `Pos/Draft/z-Listing.tsx` feeds every keystroke straight into `listing.get.search`, which rebuilds a catalogue-sized `Map` and rescoring/ sorting pass per character. The same screen also rebuilds a catalogue-wide code map (`findLineIssues`) on every cart edit, and `ListingCard` is unmemoised with inline callbacks, so one keystroke re-renders every `useSortable`/`motion` card. Small catalogues hide it; a grosir catalogue turns typing into a stutter.

reports.title: The receipt builders, the money journal and all of `src-tauri` are untested, and no test covers submit→catalogue
reports.summary: Recurring in part (iteration 1's `tests-not-wired-to-tooling` is fixed — CI now runs typecheck/lint/test). What remains is coverage shape: the receipt builders (`src/lib/receipt/*`, only `build-header` tested) and the money journal (`src/services/money/live.ts`, 382 lines, no test) are untested, which is exactly where this iteration's negative-rounding receipt bug lives. There are also zero Rust tests and no `cargo check`/`clippy` step, so `src-tauri` is only compiled at release time, and no test asserts the composite "a committed sale changes the price/stock the POS reads" that iteration 1 was about.

reports.title: The dashboard's "today" is frozen at mount, so a shop PC open past midnight reports yesterday as today
reports.summary: The Beranda dashboard derives "today" once, inside `useMemo(dayRanges, [])`, and queries on `[range.today.start]` with no record-revision dep — so an app left open across local midnight keeps showing yesterday's figures as "Pendapatan Hari Ini", and nothing short of a route remount refreshes it. `Money/use-range.tsx` freezes its default month window the same way. Every other day-scoped screen (`Record/use-records.ts`, `Debt/use-data.ts`) already subscribes to `record.get.revision`; the dashboard is the one that does not.

fix.summary:
## Fix pass — iteration 2 (8/8 reports recorded: 5 fixed, 3 partial)

**Verification:** `bun run lint` ✅, `bun run typecheck` ✅, `bun test` **224 pass / 0 fail** (was 197 pass / 1 fail at audit time — the whole-suite `listing service > repricing a listing is visible without a reload` failure is gone), `cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check` ✅ on `src-tauri`.

### Data truth
- **`catalogue-invalidation-by-wall-clock` (fixed)** — `ProductService.hydrate()` no longer decides "unchanged" from `Date.now()` timestamps alone: per-row value comparators (`sameListing`/`sameStock`/`sameProperty`/`sameProductName`/`sameImage`). The identity-reuse optimisation and "no-op hydrate emits nothing" still hold. Two frozen-clock regression tests were added and mutation-checked (removing `a.price === b.price` makes them fail).
- **`receipt-drops-negative-rounding` (fixed)** — guard is now `rounding !== 0` with an honest sign, so paper prints `Total / Pembulatan -Rp500 / Total Semua / Pembayaran / Kembalian`. `build-summary.test.ts` + `create-receipt-data.test.ts` added; flipping the guard back fails 4 tests.
- **`cart-lifecycle-errors-dropped` (fixed)** — new `transaction.reportError()` feeds the `<SaveError>` channel, `components/cart/run.ts` routes every fire-and-forget cart write into it, a rejected `add.new` renders a real "Tidak bisa memulai transaksi" + retry instead of a permanent spinner, and `delete.byId` deletes the row *before* dropping the tab from the ref (no resurrecting carts). Tests added in `flush.test.ts`.
- **`dashboard-day-frozen-at-mount` (fixed)** — new `useDayStart()/currentDayStart()` (one timer to next local midnight + focus/visibility), used by `Home/use-stats.ts` and `Money/use-range.tsx`; `useStats` also subscribes to `useRecordRevision` (moved to `src/hooks/`).

### Performance / platform
- **`pos-search-unthrottled` (partial)** — both cart searches are debounced (`use-debounce` + `DEBOUNCE_DELAY`), `matching()` caches its id map by array identity, `findLineIssues` caches the catalogue code map, and the cart cards are `memo`'d with stable per-line handlers. Measured: one query over 5,000 listings is ~19 ms of scoring, so the new timing test guards at <25 ms — the scoring ladder itself was not reworked.
- **`print-commands-block-main-thread` (fixed)** — both printer commands are `async` + `spawn_blocking`, the not-found path enumerates the spooler once, success says "Dikirim ke printer", dead `PrintResult` removed.

### Structure / testing
- **`pos-restock-cart-duplication` (partial)** — `src/pages/_cart/` is gone (→ `src/components/cart/`), one shared `components/cart/types.ts` replaces `Pos/mock.ts` + `Restock/types.ts` (`EXTRA_PRESETS` → `Pos/presets.ts`), and the byte-identical `z-Discount`/`z-ExtraSearch`/`z-Total` are single copies. Duplication diff 18 files/658+525 → 14 files/651+513. **Still open:** the two `Draft/` trees are not collapsed into one mode-branched component; the two grids (`listing-grid`/`extra-grid`, Pos-only `toggle` cell, Restock-only `subtotal` row) are what block sharing `z-Extra`, `z-ListingCard`, `z-Methods`, `z-Listing`, `Draft/index.tsx`.
- **`receipt-money-rust-untested` (partial)** — receipt builders, `money/live.ts` (6 tests) and the submit→catalogue composite are now tested; CI has a `rust` job (`cargo fmt --check` + `clippy -D warnings`, two real fixes needed: `printer.rs` formatting and a `needless_return` in `database/mod.rs`). **Still open:** no test asserts the bytes handed to the printer, no Rust unit tests, e2e still non-blocking.

### For the next auditor
1. Collapse `Pos/Draft` + `Restock/Draft` behind one `CartDraft` with `mode` + slots; unify the two grid modules first.
2. The 5,000-listing scoring pass (~19 ms) is the next real perf win — a cheap prefilter before `gradeText`.
3. `run.ts` deliberately imports the `~/services` singleton to report failures; if the service layer moves, that coupling needs a reporter prop.
4. Watch `sameState`: any new child field added to `ProductState` must be added to its comparator, or identity reuse can hide a write again.

fixes.note: `buildSummarySection` now guards on `record.rounding !== 0` and signs with `rounding < 0 ? "-" : ""`, so a rounded-down sale prints `Total`, `Pembulatan -Rp500`, `Total Semua Rp100.000` and then `Pembayaran`/`Kembalian` — the same shape as the positive case, matching the screen (`Record/Item/z-Receipt/z-Summary.tsx` already used `!== 0`). Added `src/lib/receipt/build-summary.test.ts` (zero/positive/negative rounding + extras ordering, asserting the exact ordered label set and `-Rp500`) and `src/lib/receipt/create-receipt-data.test.ts` (full `createReceiptData` line order incl. `-Rp500` and `Total Semua`, plus a no-`undefined`/`NaN` guard). `build-transaction-summary.ts` has no rounding guard; nothing else prints rounding.

Replaced the timestamp-only identity check in `ProductService.hydrate()` with value-by-value comparators (`sameListing`/`sameStock`/`sameProperty`/`sameProductName`/`sameImage`, wired through a generic `sameChildren(a, b, same)`), keeping the timestamp fields as one input but no longer as the only signal — two writes inside one `Date.now()` millisecond can no longer read back as "unchanged". The identity optimisation itself is preserved: an untouched product keeps its object, a no-op hydrate still emits nothing. Added two deterministic regression tests in `src/services/product/live.test.ts` (frozen `Date.now()`: a listing price edit and a `stock.receive` in the same millisecond both reach `get.all()`/`get.byId()`), verified they fail under timestamp-only comparison. `bun test` full suite: 207 pass / 0 fail (previously the listing repricing test failed in the whole-suite run). Not done: the `hydrate({touched})` scoping recommended as option 1 — that is a larger refactor, and the content comparison is sound on its own.

Landed the first two steps of the report's plan (the ones with no design decisions): (1) `src/pages/_cart/` is gone — the shared cart primitives (`z-Cell`, `z-Issue`, `z-Note`, `z-Precision`, `z-SearchResults`, `code-issues` + test, `util-rupiah`, `run`) now live in `src/components/cart/`, with all 53 `~/pages/_cart/…` imports rewritten and no `src/pages/**` → other-page import left for them. (2) One type module: new `src/components/cart/types.ts` holds `Line`/`Extra`/`ExtraPreset`/`DiscountLine`/`DiscountKind`; `Pos/mock.ts` and `Restock/types.ts` are deleted, and the only live thing `mock.ts` carried (`EXTRA_PRESETS`) moved to `src/pages/Pos/presets.ts` — no production module named "mock" remains. (3) Merged the now-byte-identical duplicated components into `src/components/cart/`: `z-Discount.tsx` (401 lines, was copied twice), `z-ExtraSearch.tsx`, and `z-Total.tsx` — the Restock copy of `z-Total` had silently lost Pos's `data-testid="grand-total"`, which is exactly the drift class the report describes, and both screens now have it back. Duplication measure: `git diff --no-index --stat Pos/Draft Restock/Draft` went from 18 files/658+525 to 14 files/651+513. **Remaining (still the core of the report, needs a design pass, not a mechanical move):** the two `Draft/` trees themselves are not collapsed into one mode-branched `CartDraft`; `listing-grid.ts`/`extra-grid.ts` still differ by the Pos-only `toggle` header cell and the Restock-only `subtotal` row, which is what blocks sharing `z-Extra.tsx`, `z-ListingCard.tsx` (drifted: testid + "Harga Jual"/"Harga Beli" label), `z-Methods.tsx`, `z-Listing.tsx` and `Draft/index.tsx`. Unifying the two grids behind a `mode`/header-cell prop is the next cheapest step and would unlock those five files.

Three changes, each closing one of the report's failure paths. (1) **No more silent drops**: `components/cart/run.ts` now catches the effect's failure and routes it to `service.transaction.reportError(...)` — a new service method that writes to the same `saveErrorRef` `<SaveError>` renders (plus `log.error`), so every fire-and-forget cart edit (note, precision, rounding, methods, customer/supplier, images, tab delete, title, listings/extras) has a visible channel. `Effect.runFork` in `Pos/page.tsx`, `Restock/page.tsx` and both `Draft/index.tsx` goes through it; the remaining `runFork`s under `src/pages/**` are `Fiber.interrupt`/upload fibers, not cart writes. The two `then(onSelect, () => {})` new-tab buttons in `z-Tabs.tsx` and the `storeCart`/`openDraft` park+restore paths now use `Effect.either` and toast the message instead of dropping it, and an F12/`add.new` rejection sets the start-error state. (2) **No more permanent spinner**: both pages track `startError` + a `retry` token; a rejected `add.new` (nothing is written, so the "always have a cart" effect never re-ran) now renders a new `components/cart/z-StartError.tsx` — "Tidak bisa memulai transaksi" + the message + a `Coba lagi` button that re-arms the effect. (3) **Deleted carts cannot resurrect**: `transaction.delete.byId` now deletes the `tx_records` row *first* and only then removes the draft from the ref (and `written`), so a failed delete leaves the tab visible instead of bringing it back with its parked lines on the next hydrate. Tests added in `src/services/transaction/flush.test.ts` (the flaky DB layer now also fails `execute`): a failed delete leaves both the draft and the row; a successful one removes both; `reportError` reaches the `saveError` channel. `bun test` 210 pass. **Remaining**: the failures that reach the operator via `toast`/`SaveError` are still transient (no retry button on a failed delete — the tab simply stays), and `flush.test.ts`'s failure hook is test-only, so the "corrupt `tx.db`" manual scenario was not exercised end to end.

Four changes. (1) **Debounce**: both `Pos/Draft/z-Listing.tsx` and `Restock/Draft/z-Listing.tsx` now split the search into `input` (what the field shows, and what opens the results pane) and `query` (fed to `listing.get.search` through `useDebouncedCallback(setQuery, DEBOUNCE_DELAY)` — the same `use-debounce` + `DEBOUNCE_DELAY` the Product/Extra/Record searches use). Picking a listing cancels the pending push and clears both. So one query per pause, not per character. (2) `ListingService.matching()` no longer rebuilds a catalogue-sized `Map` per query: `listingById()` caches the id→Listing map against the `toListings()` array identity, which is stable until the catalogue changes. (3) `findLineIssues` no longer rebuilds the catalogue code map on every cart edit — new `buildCatalogByCode(catalog)` caches it by array identity (the `listing.get.changes` array), and `findLineIssues` takes it as an optional third argument defaulting to the cache. (4) Cards are memoised: both `ListingCard`s are `memo(...)`, and each `z-Listing` now hands them a per-line handler set (`handlersFor(line.id)`, memoised in a `Map`, reading `lines`/`onChange`/`removeCard` through a ref) instead of inline lambdas, so a keystroke in the search bar or in one cell no longer re-renders every `useSortable`/`motion` node. Added two tests in `src/lib/search/listings.test.ts`: a 5,000-listing timing guard and "many queries reuse one index". **Measured, not asserted-away:** one query over 5,000 listings still costs ~19 ms in the scoring pass (four `gradeText` calls per entry), so the timing guard is `perQuery < 25 ms` and documented as a regression bound, not the report's suggested 8 ms target — I did not rework the scoring ladder, which is the next real step if that number matters (e.g. an `indexOf`/first-char prefilter before `gradeText`). Not verified by a profiler in the app: the "30 cart lines, one price edit re-renders only that card" claim rests on the memo + stable handlers, not on React DevTools.

`get_printers` and `print_pdf` in `src-tauri/src/printer.rs` are now `async fn`s that run their body on `tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking`, mirroring `auth.rs`'s bcrypt handling with a comment explaining the hazard — so Win32 printer enumeration, the temp-PDF write and `WinPdfPrinter::print` no longer run on the webview's main thread and a slow/offline printer can't freeze the POS right after Bayar. `validate_pdf` still runs before the hop, so a non-PDF buffer fails without touching the pool. Also in the same file: the Windows not-found path no longer calls `PrinterDevice::all()` a second time (and drops its `unwrap_or_default()`), the success string now says `Dikirim ke printer '<name>'` instead of "Successfully sent …" because the spooler accepting a job is not the paper coming out, and the unused `PrintResult` struct is gone (it was the only dead-code warning in the crate). `cargo check` passes clean on the Linux target. **Not verifiable here:** the Windows `winprint` branch compiles only on a Windows host — I kept the change to shapes that need no new bound (no `Clone` on `PrinterDevice`, a `fn` item passed to `spawn_blocking`), but it should be confirmed with `cargo check` on Windows. No Rust test was added for these (report 7 covers the missing Rust job).

Added `src/hooks/use-day-start.ts` — `useDayStart()` returns today's local midnight and re-arms itself with a single `setTimeout` to the next local midnight (no `setInterval`) plus `window.focus` / `visibilitychange` listeners for a machine that wakes up, and `currentDayStart()` / `untilNextMidnight()` as pure helpers. `Home/use-stats.ts` now derives its ranges from it (`useMemo(() => dayRanges(dayStart), [dayStart])`) instead of `useMemo(..., [])`, so "Pendapatan Hari Ini"/"Kemarin" roll over at midnight without a route remount; `Money/use-range.tsx` anchors its default "last month" window on the same value. `useStats` also gained the record-revision dep (and `keepPrevious: true`, like the other day-scoped screens), so a commit landing while Beranda is mounted refreshes the numbers — previously nothing short of navigating away did. To keep it from being a page→page import, `useRecordRevision` moved out of `Record/use-records.ts` into `src/hooks/use-record-revision.ts` (its three importers updated). Tests: `src/hooks/use-day-start.test.ts` asserts the day start is the *local* midnight (a UTC midnight would read as hour 8), the timer waits exactly to the next midnight, and a backwards clock jump never yields a negative wait. `Record/use-time.ts` was already computing `getDay` per render, so it needed no change.

Filled the highest-value gaps. (1) **Receipt builders**: `src/lib/receipt/build-summary.test.ts` (zero/up/down rounding + extras, asserting the exact ordered rows) and `src/lib/receipt/create-receipt-data.test.ts` (section order, `paperWidth` plumbing, `-Rp500` and `Total Semua` in the emitted lines, no `undefined`/`NaN`). Mutation-verified: flipping the rounding guard back to `> 0` fails 4 tests. (2) **Money journal**: new `src/services/money/live.test.ts` against `makeTestDatabase()` — a card shows its most recent entry regardless of insert order, entries sharing an instant resolve identically in the card and the history, `last` is the value in force before an instant (0 before anything), deleting a pocket hides it and its entries, deleting an entry falls back to the previous one, and a reorder changes the catalog order without touching balances. (3) **submit→catalogue composite**: new `src/services/transaction/catalogue.test.ts` submits a sale and asserts, in the same tick, that `product.get.byId` *and* `listing.get.all()` both show stock 7→6 with the price intact, plus a frozen-`Date.now` repricing case — the regression lock for both iteration 1's stale-catalogue bug and report 1's wall-clock detector (`bun test` 224 pass). (4) **Rust in CI**: added a `rust` job to `.github/workflows/windows-release.yml` running `cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` on ubuntu behind rust-cache (well under two minutes). Making that green required two real fixes: `cargo fmt` on `printer.rs` and removing a `needless_return` in `src-tauri/src/database/mod.rs` (the migration list is unchanged, only the `let`/`return` wrapper around it). **Remaining, not done:** no test for the print pipeline (`programPrintReceipt` → `printPdf`) asserting the bytes handed to the printer equal `createReceiptData(record, width)`, no Rust unit tests inside `src-tauri` (`clippy` compiles, it does not assert), and the e2e job is still `continue-on-error` — the "sale reduces the stock shown on the POS card" flow was covered at the service level instead of in `e2e/`, so the e2e job has not been made blocking.
